newsitem.title: USA: JULY U.S. MAGAZINE ADS UP 12.5 PCT VS YR AGO-GROUP.
newsitem.headline: JULY U.S. MAGAZINE ADS UP 12.5 PCT VS YR AGO-GROUP.

text.p: U.S. magazine advertising revenue totalled $789.5 million in July, up 12.5 percent from the same period a year ago, according to the Publishers Information Bureau.
Ad pages for the month rose five percent to 14,426.47, said the bureau, a unit of the Magazine Publishers of America.
For the period of January through July, revenue rose 12.3 percent to $6.77 billion, while pages gained 5.1 percent to 124,031.77.
The trade group said the year-to-date ad pages data was the second biggest growth since 1984.
Automotive showed the biggest revenues gains in July among categories, up 33.7 percent to $147.4 million, followed by publishing and media, rising 58.8 percent to about $20 million.
